      const linkUrl = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DerrativeWork/Appache.Licence.2.0@HEAD/LICENSE';

      fetch(linkUrl)
        .then(response => {
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
          }
          return response.text();
        })
        .then(text => {
          const messageElement = document.getElementById('message');
          messageElement.textContent = text;
          messageElement.removeAttribute('hidden');
        })
        .catch(error => {
          console.error('There was a problem fetching the text:', error);
        });
    
  

  
    let assetMap = new Map();

    const folderInput = document.getElementById('folderInput');
    const assetInfo = document.getElementById('assetInfo');

    folderInput.addEventListener('change', e => {
      assetMap.clear();
      const files = e.target.files;

      if (files.length === 0) {
        assetInfo.classList.remove('active');
        return;
      }

      for (let file of files) {
        assetMap.set(file.webkitRelativePath, file);
      }

      assetInfo.textContent = `Loaded ${files.length} asset(s)`;
      assetInfo.classList.add('active');
    });

    const fileInput = document.getElementById('fileInput');

    fileInput.addEventListener('change', e => {
      const file = e.target.files[0];
      if (file && file.type === 'text/html') {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(ev) {
          const newTab = window.open();
          if (!newTab) {
            alert('Please allow pop-ups for this site.');
            fileInput.value = '';
            return;
          }

          const blobUrls = new Map();
          const promises = [];

          for (let [path, file] of assetMap) {
            const promise = new Promise((resolve) => {
              const reader = new FileReader();
              reader.onload = function(e) {
                const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([e.target.result], { type: file.type }));
                blobUrls.set(path, blobUrl);
                resolve();
              };
              reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
            });
            promises.push(promise);
          }

          Promise.all(promises).then(() => {

            let html = ev.target.result;

            for (let [originalPath, blobUrl] of blobUrls) {
              const fileName = originalPath.split('/').pop();
              const regex = new RegExp(`(?:src=["']|href=["']|url\\(["']?)(?:\\.?\\/)?${fileName.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}`, 'g');
              html = html.replace(regex, `$&`.replace(fileName, blobUrl));
            }

            html = html.replace(/(?:src=["']|href=["']|url\(["']?)(\.?\/?[^"')]+)/g, (match, path) => {
              for (let [originalPath, blobUrl] of blobUrls) {
                if (originalPath.endsWith(path) || originalPath.endsWith('/' + path) || path.endsWith(originalPath)) {
                  return match.replace(path, blobUrl);
                }
              }
              return match;
            });

            newTab.document.open();
            newTab.document.write(html);
            newTab.document.close();

            newTab.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
              blobUrls.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
            });

            fileInput.value = '';
          });
        };
        reader.readAsText(file);
      } else {
        alert('Please select a valid HTML file.');
        fileInput.value = '';
      }
    });

    document.getElementById('stuffButton').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const message = document.getElementById('message');
      message.hidden = false;
    });
